user.title: Add Remote Property
user.description:
Connect a remote Home Assistant instance (one rental property) to this central Property Bridge portal.

You can use a local IP, Tailscale hostname, Nabu Casa (e.g. abcd1234.ui.nabu.casa), or DuckDNS (e.g. myhouse.duckdns.org).

data.host: Host / IP / Tailscale / Nabu Casa / DuckDNS
data.port: Port (leave 8123 for local; 443 is used automatically for Nabu Casa & DuckDNS)
data.create_area: Automatically create Area for this property
data.create_label: Automatically create Label for this property

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the remote Home Assistant. Check host, port, token and network. For Nabu Casa / DuckDNS use the hostname only (e.g. abcd1234.ui.nabu.casa or myhouse.duckdns.org) and leave Secure ON.
error.invalid_ssl: SSL certificate problem. Try turning off 'Verify SSL certificate' for self-signed certificates, or make sure you are using the correct HTTPS URL.

abort.already_configured: This property / host combination is already configured.

data.create_area: Create / keep Area for this property
data.create_label: Create / keep Label for this property
